knowledge_graph.title: Grove City High School
knowledge_graph.type: High school in Grove City, Ohio
knowledge_graph.description: Grove City High School is a high school in Grove City, Ohio, United States. It is one of the five high schools in the South-Western City Schools district. It houses about 1,900 students in grades 9-12.
